title: Surreal AI Circus - Man On The Trapeze | 4K
description:
I know this one won't be for everyone. Some people have a hard time with clowns. I rather like this creepy circus. The song gives it a fun feeling though.  I was also named after a clown. Emmett Kelly, who I believe picked my mom up at the circus when she was a little girl...if I remember the story right. It makes sense though as I am a clown ;-).  I found a fun style ref code and got these crazy creatures and wacky clowns. And apparently they built in the part about over endowing the women LOL. I did not prompt for that. The song is called 'Man On The Trapeze.'
 
[Verse 1]
There was a time of order,
A neat and tidy border,
Soldiers marching, keeping time.
Then the Big Top swayed,
The whole procession frayed,
And the clowns came tumbling down the line.
 
[Pre-Chorus]
Nothing's on purpose,
Everything's a circus,
The moon paints her porcelain face.
No wrong and no right,
Just sawdust and spotlight,
And nobody's keeping their place.
 
[Chorus]
There's a man on the trapeze,
Catching air on borrowed knees,
Fighting gravity with a grin.
Nobody's watching him fall,
Nobody's watching at all,
But he keeps on swinging again.
 
[Verse 2]
The tightrope walker tips,
The aerialist slips,
The lion tamer's lost the cage.
The magician's rabbit ran,
No trick, no backup plan,
Just another clown on the stage.
 
[Pre-Chorus]
A girl in the stands,
Flowers in her hands,
All she ever wanted was romance.
The clowns took the door,
She doesn't know what for,
So she's learning to love the last dance.
 
[Chorus]
There's a man on the trapeze,
Catching air on borrowed knees,
Fighting gravity with a grin.
Nobody's watching him fall,
Nobody's watching at all,
But he keeps on swinging again.

#ai #aiart #aivideo #music #surreal
